title: Life Path — Rwanda CRVS 2025 Data Decisions & Caveats
source_report: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Systems (CRVS) Annual Report 2025, NISR Rwanda

issue_1_figure19_last_bucket.problem: Labels jump from 75-79 to 85+ without an 80-84 row.
issue_1_figure19_last_bucket.resolution: Total sums exactly to 39,355 without an 80-84 row; treated as 80+ and referenced by key 'age.last_bucket'.

issue_2_conflicting_totals.problem: Deaths differ between sheet 10.2 (39,378) and Table 12 (39,355). Marriages differ between Table 18 (52,878) and sheet 10.10 (52,806).
issue_2_conflicting_totals.resolution: Standardized on Table 12 for mortality (39,355 in 2025) and Table 18 for nuptiality (50,256 in 2025).

issue_3_under_registration.problem: Death registration completeness is only 50.5% in 2025, compared to 92.9% for births.
issue_3_under_registration.resolution: Strictly labeled as 'registered deaths', never 'risk of dying' or 'true mortality distribution'.

issue_4_divorces_not_a_rate.problem: 4,479 registered divorces vs 50,256 marriages does not equal a 9% divorce rate.
issue_4_divorces_not_a_rate.resolution: Cohorts differ, and 41.3% of divorces were granted in prior years. Displayed as separate indicators.

issue_5_composite_life.problem: The player walks one life, but the data is a 2025 cross-section plus 2019-2025 historical trends.
issue_5_composite_life.resolution: Framed in the intro and documented in the methodology panel.
